areas.text: This element contains Command and Control (C2) NS Equipment Rack Variants for the MMIII Secondary Launch Platform - Airborne (SLP-A). Scope includes design, procurement, receipt and checkout, test planning/execution/reporting through the end of the EMD contract. The remaining scope includes requirement analysis and decomposition from the level 3 node specification to the Integrated LRUs and other lower level specifications as well as development, review and release of all associated CDRLs.
​​ Without a description of scope and expected deliveries that would be further expanded on from a BOE, an estimation of IMS-loading cant be performed, making this a high risk​.
